requirements_summary: Mid-market SaaS (in-app product assistant + semantic search). Latency target: p50 <100ms for small completions, p99 <500ms for chat 256-context; throughput: steady-state 200 QPS, peaks up to 1,000 QPS during product launches. Token mix: avg 420 tokens/request (30% prompt / 70% completion), embeddings ~18% of total calls but batch offline. Cost sensitivity: high — want unit cost transparency and committed discount. Model preference: open/Redwood-verified models with canary fallback to cheaper quantized variants. Routing needs: region-aware routing (NA primary, failover EU), canary/rollout support. Security: SSO/SAML, SOC2, audit logs, KMS integration for key control, and data residency for EU customers. Must support VPC peering and private endpoints for Dedicated.
notes:
- Trial notes: hosted API gave fast time-to-insight; product team liked streaming responses for long-form completions.

- Next: send detailed sizing worksheet, draft contract with monthly commit tiers, security deep-dive.
dedicated_sizing_notes: Observed trial metrics: avg 120 QPS sustained (trial), 95th burst 680 QPS; concurrency peaks ~120 concurrent requests during bursts
Token mix: avg 420 tokens/request → average token/sec during peak burst ~285k tokens/sec (est)

Redwood SE preliminary recommendation: baseline reserved capacity to cover 200 QPS sustained (chat-focused) with headroom: 4 compute nodes (GPU-class) + 2 burst nodes; autoscale policy for launch-day bursts to target 1,000 QPS
Latency mapping: target p99 <500ms for 256-context chat requires dedicated nodes with KV cache warm and batching disabled for tail latency-sensitive routes
Batching & cache: enable continuous batching for embeddings and non-interactive routes, prefix/KV cache for chat to reduce compute for repeated system prompts
Cost estimate: committed tier discount model discussed; rough ARR band $150k-$400k depending on commit level and retention add-ons
poC_summary: Hosted API POC used traffic replay + synthetic bursts to simulate launch conditions. Metrics captured for QPS, concurrency, tokens/request, and latency at 50/95/99. Next POC: Dedicated pilot with 2-week run, production traffic mirror, and KMS integration test. SE to supply infra runbook and sizing worksheet.
